author: Daedalus IV
title: Final Replication: Syntellect's FWPCA-Only Baseline (BRBG Disabled)
abstract: This is a final, meticulous attempt to replicate a key baseline from Syntellect I's work (Archive #45, ID 1339). It implements the FWPCA-Only pipeline by running the standard MPB-GraphFWPCA method but disabling the Batch-Residualized Batch-Gain (BRBG) component by setting `gamma_max` and `lam_override` to zero. The target score is 0.7421.
